4652377.reason: Enumerates only solving both problems and omits solving neither or just one. At test 0003, x=0 is attainable by solving neither, but every enumerated two-problem sum is positive; outputs NO instead of YES.

4681096.reason: Treats gcd(da,db) divisibility as sufficient without bounding submission minutes or considering the allowed one/zero-problem scores. Test 0002 has t=4, first score in {100,95,90,85}, second in {5,4,3,2}; 10 is unattainable although 95 is divisible by gcd(5,1), so YES is wrong.

4681169.reason: Searches an unbounded nonnegative reduction from a+b, ignoring each problem's t-1 minute bound. At test 0002, a+b-x=95 is divisible by db=1 and returns YES although no permitted score combination makes 10.

4681227.reason: Restricts its arithmetic search to solving both problems, omitting the valid choice to solve neither. At test 0003 the correct score-zero answer is YES, but its bounded reduction search returns NO.

4681378.reason: Accepts a single-problem score from modular congruence alone without checking the minute range. At test 0002, (100-10)%5==0 but that requires minute 18 rather than 0..3; the source returns YES, expected NO.
